subject: planner: use collected predicate columns to do stats sync load (#56813)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent (95b04c7670). Core changes refactor predicate-column collection to return a per-column FullLoad flag, use those collected predicate columns to drive stats sync-load requests (plus static-partition expansion), and refactor session stats-usage plumbing to take iterators (iter.Seq). Statistics load bookkeeping is adjusted by setting ColAndIdxExistenceMap checked after storage reads and removing an apparently inverted Checked() gate in ColumnIsLoadNeeded. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, concurrency, or session/runtime behavior within the scoped modules.
